text:
I'm heading to Corvanta's session in Midtown next Tuesday: "Operationalizing AI-native revenue intelligence at enterprise scale."

The title is a mouthful, but the idea underneath it is one every GTM team knows: the forecast call on the last two weeks of the quarter is usually part math, part gut feel.

Corvanta's product reads a sales team's call recordings and CRM history and flags deals likely to slip in the current quarter. One customer, a 200-rep software company, says it cut its end-of-quarter forecast miss from 18% to 7%. That's a claim I'd like to hear unpacked. What did the team change once it saw the flags? How did reps react? What did the first quarter look like?

Tomasz Arkwright-Bell, Corvanta's head of sales operations, is speaking, so I'm hoping for the view from someone who runs this day to day, not just a product demo.

If you work in sales ops, RevOps, or forecasting and you're in New York, it looks worth the evening. I'll share what I learn.

Anyone else going? Happy to meet up beforehand.
